name: Shroud of Caustic Mist
body:
School conjuration (creation) [acid]; Level alchemist 1, bloodrager 1, druid/shaman 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1
Components V, S, M (a vial of acid)

This spell functions as shroud of icy mist except you create a swirling acidic mist around the target and the spell deals acid damage instead of cold damage.
